preconditions.description: k is an integer between 1 and 18 inclusive.
The length of the string s is 2^k - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1', '?'} for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each character in the string s is either '0', '1', or '?'.
q is an integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= 2**k - 1 and c in {'0', '1', '?'} for p, c in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of an integer p between 1 and 2^k - 1 and a character c which is either '0', '1', or '?'.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result of the query is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= result <= 2**k for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result of the query is an integer between 1 and 2^k inclusive.
